Package com.example.lotterize.ui.notifications

Class NotificationsViewModel

ViewModel
com.example.lotterize.ui.notifications.NotificationsViewModel
public class NotificationsViewModel extends ViewModel
This is a ViewModel that provides notification data to the notifications screen. It owns the Firestore snapshot listener, transforms Firestore documents into Notification objects, and exposes them via
invalid reference 
LiveData
.

  • Constructor Details

    • NotificationsViewModel

      public NotificationsViewModel()
      Creates a NotificationsViewModel with the real production dependencies.

      This constructor is used by the app at runtime via ViewModelProvider. It:

      • Uses
        invalid reference 
        FirebaseFirestore#getInstance()
        as the backing database,
      • Creates a new NotificationSender for sending notifications,
      • Reads the current user id from CurrentUser,
      • Immediately starts listening for notification updates by calling startListening().

    • NotificationsViewModel

      public NotificationsViewModel(FirebaseFirestore db, NotificationSender sender, String currentUserId, boolean attachListener)
      A constructor primarily intended for tests.

      It allows injecting a custom

      invalid reference 
      FirebaseFirestore
      instance and NotificationSender, as well as a specific currentUserId, and lets the caller decide whether to attach the Firestore snapshot listener immediately.
      Parameters:
      db - the Firestore instance used to query and listen for notifications
      sender - the helper responsible for sending notifications
      currentUserId - the id of the user whose notifications should be observed
      attachListener - if true, this constructor calls startListening() immediately; if false, no listener is attached and the caller may invoke startListening() manually (e.g., in tests)

  • Method Details

    • sendToStatus

      public void sendToStatus(String eventId, String listStatus, String message, String senderId)
      This fetches the event’s recipient list (by listStatus) from Firestore and sends message to those user IDs via NotificationSender. Posts a short status to toast (not found / empty / sent / failure).
      Parameters:
      eventId - Event document ID
      listStatus - Field name holding recipients
      message - The message of Notification
      senderId - ID of the user sending the notification
